h1: Tube notchers and pipe notching machines
intro: A tube notcher (pipe notcher or coping machine) grinds a saddle-shaped notch into the end of a tube so it fits tightly against the tube it joins — the joint of every welded handrail, roll cage, trailer, gate and furniture frame. İşitan's PN belt-sander notchers cope that saddle in seconds, square or at any angle up to 50°, with ten dovetail drums from Ø3/4″ to 3″ included so the notch matches the mating tube; the TD-01 wire-brush deburring machine cleans the cut end inside and out in one pass before it goes to the notcher or the bender. Both sit beside the cold saw and take the hand grinding out of tube fabrication — with CSA-approved panels and support from Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: What is a tube notcher for?
faq.a: When one tube meets another in a T or at an angle — handrail posts, roll cages, furniture and bike frames, trailer and gate frames — the end has to be coped to the curve of the tube it joins so the weld closes without gaps. The PN notcher grinds that saddle on a sanding belt against a drum of the mating tube's diameter in seconds, square or at any angle to 50°.

The PN 17/90 takes the larger range, 11/16″ to 3-1/2″ OD, on a 4 × 47″ belt with easy belt adjustment. The PN 20/76 is the compact notcher for 13/16″ to 3″ OD with a longer 4 × 79″ belt and a movable clamp. Both come with the same ten dovetail drums and 3 HP motor.

A hole-saw notcher cuts the cope with a hole saw of the mating tube's diameter — slow, and the saw dulls on stainless. The PN grinds the cope on a sanding belt wrapped around a dovetail drum, so it is faster, works on any material and leaves a clean, square-to-weld edge; the drum is swapped in seconds for the next tube size.

faq.q: Does the notcher deburr the tube as well?
faq.a: No — the notcher shapes the cope. The TD-01 is the machine that removes the burr left by the saw: a Ø10″ wire brush cleans the inside and outside of the tube end in one pass, on round, square and rectangular tube to Ø3-1/2″, so the tube is ready to notch, bend or weld.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
